column1: # The special-item rows of the U-Use picker, one at a time.
# Seeded rather than walked to. The walk-up form of this scenario scripted its
# way in from the town gate, and the resident walks its own schedule while
# those steps run, so the two sides arrived with it in different cells and
# every later beat compared unrelated windows (`cleak/u5-engine#22`).
# `qa/tools/reseed.py` replayed that walk once into the seed named below.
# The picker panel is a repaint without a clear (`inventory.md` §4.4), so the
# scrolled beats carry the previous pass's pixels on purpose: a second
# ` 1 Sceptre`, a second `Shard/Falsehd`, a stray `S` in column 0, `ed` past
# the wrap and a `d` in window column 15 that outlives the picker. Measured
# 2026-10-17 on rc1; the engine paints the same residue since `fcaf8e53`.
# `sceptre`, screen row 7: with the §4.4 inverse leak set, the stock divider
# band draws the ribbon end caps beside the crown as solid dark arrows -
# published in §4.4 (u5-spec#299 Q12) and drawn by the engine since spec2-c2.
# The rc4 sweep (20261020-161139) still read row 7 different, in one cell:
# window column 15, whose residue `d` the stock leaves exactly as the picker
# drew it (inverted on row 7, plain beside `G:150` on row 8) while the boxes
# invert; the engine toggled those cells from an assumed clear bit and
# swapped the two. Fixed on rc4.

column4: Journey Onward on the seeded cell
